read_first: only due-date index/day shards through the requested horizon
exact host shards referenced by due events
only the due or causally awakened domain owners
write_order: resolve due work from the causal scheduler without broad directory/person scans
settle awakened owners and supported successors in chronological order
persist authoritative domain-owner effects before declaring their causal events settled
advance host resolved_through/safe_through and enqueue exact successor wakes
advance scheduler and campaign clocks to the exact reached time and end with no overdue causal event
invariants: A safe horizon is a causal proof that no earlier outward wake is pending, not evidence of periodic polling.
Owner-local schedules and causal wake-ups override slower aggregate baselines.
Material autonomous actions are instantiated and persisted in their domain authority before successor resolution continues.
Internal causal settlement never becomes a player decision merely because a scheduler boundary was processed.
A player-facing report, offer, contact, or public consequence may stop event-seeking downtime for narration without closing time passage or implying consent.
decision_required is reserved for a protected hard player decision and must not coexist with an otherwise open time-passage handoff.
Production boundary discovery scales with queued causal work, not total named-person count.
Routine birthdays are derived from birth dates and do not require global scans or annual per-person events unless an outward material consequence is explicitly scheduled.
The causal scheduler root plus its deterministic host/event shards form one writable temporal-frontier authority; no monolithic shadow registry exists.
Scheduler host count and pending-event count are logical-world cardinalities, never validity ceilings; bounded settlement budgets return a resumable frontier instead of rejecting a large world.
When a soft work budget is reached, settlement stops only between causal timestamps so committing the reached world clock cannot strand overdue work at the same timestamp.
Advance-time discovery cost follows due event days and referenced hosts, not total future scheduler cardinality; exact host mutation routes by deterministic hash shard.
